question: catalog_sadness
label: approximate
sources: pdt search --catalog text filter [sad, hopeless, depress, feel down, feeling down]
notes: Text search is always approximate. Waves for the last six GSS variables (nocheer, hopeless, unhappy, hlthdep, feeldown, emoprobs) were not read because of the token budget; they are listed as candidates with empty waves. yrbss year list for q26/qn26 is the 1999-2023 range expanded to the odd survey years. Excluded: brfss MENTHLTH (days mental health not good), ADDEPEV2/3 (told have depressive disorder), yrbss q84, and GSS help-seeking/treatment/vignette variables (down1, treat10, depress, etc.), which are not about the respondent's own sadness. cesd and sad appear to be single-wave items.
